intent.caption: Data ticker ribbon — A horizontal data ribbon of mono figures scrolling with constant velocity and edge fades.

visualSpec.effects: Ribbon plane 7.0w x 0.35h scene units centered at origin, albedo #111117, top and bottom 0.006-unit hairlines #23232b, roughness 0.6, metalness 0.2; ticker entries set in mono 700 paper on a single baseline, separated by vertical accent tick marks 0.02w x 0.14h in #ff2a38 emissive intensity 1.5 with 0.5-unit gaps (2x base unit) on both sides of each tick, never punctuation glyphs; content strip duplicated for a seamless loop and translated x at constant velocity 0.4 scene units per second leftward (fly-through primitive, speed 0.4, depthUnits 0), linear timing cubic-bezier(0,0,1,1), loop period equal to strip length divided by 0.4 with zero visible seam; edge fade masks 0.6 units wide at both ends using the stop ramp #0b0b10ff (at 0.0) -> #0b0b1000 (at 0.09) and mirrored at the right so figures dissolve into the stage rather than clipping; figures float translateZ +0.02 above the rail so the key light gives the mono digits a crisp top edge; no vertical motion, no easing changes, the ribbon reads as instrumentation.

sceneSpec.motionNote: The figure strip translates left at a constant 0.4 scene units per second in a seamless loop; entries dissolve through 0.6-unit edge fades.
sceneSpec.contrastMinimum: 4.5:1 figures on ribbon surface at full opacity zone
